text:
zoe: Quick note: onboarding OrionBridge-9B (converted from hybrid Llama->Gemma export) onto dedicated. Ran an int4 smoke and saw a repeatable quality drop on summarization and a funky tokenization mismatch for ZWJ/combining sequences.
zoe: fp16 baseline Rouge-L 39.6 -> int4 35.0, BLEU 21.0 -> 17.8. PPL dev 12.6 -> 16.1. Not huge but consistent across seeds and truncation settings.
miguel: did you run the token-map diff? the converter sometimes inserts/removes explicit ZWJ tokens or changes unicode normalization.
zoe: yes. scripts/token_map_diff.py shows ~0.27% mismatches concentrated in U+0300..U+036F and U+200D zone. sample lines: 
```
orig U+0301 -> id 17912
conv  U+0301 -> id 17913
orig [U+1F469,U+200D,U+1F4BB] -> [345,200,789]
conv [U+1F469,U+200D,U+1F4BB] -> [345,201,789]
```
rahul: thanks. another red flag: k-v cache warmup traces show headwise banding after ~800 tokens. looks like rotary application is misaligned with head ordering. I suspect a head-dim reshape changed qkv head packing order during conversion but rotary arrays were left as-is.
miguel: yep. two likely culprits: (A) tokenizer normalizer changed (NFKC vs NFC) shifting contiguous combining-range ids, (B) head-index permutation so rotary.freq no longer aligns with q/k head slices.
zoe: I dumped the first 128 rotary.freq values from both checkpoints. converted looks permuted and has a slightly different scale factor on alternating groups. snippet: 
```
# converted
[0.998, 1.002, 1.250, 1.248, 0.999, 1.003, 1.251, 1.249]
# original
[1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000, 1.000]
```
miguel: that alternating ~1.25 factor smells like a head-group rescale introduced by the exporter (per-head quant scaling or old-layout assumption). if rotary gets a different base per head, mixing them with permuted q/k will definitely break longctx.
rahul: experimental plan: run three quick dev experiments on the same snapshot: (1) embed-id remap only (map conv ids -> orig ids, remap embedding matrix + tied lm_head), (2) rotary-permute only (permute rotary.freq and q/k/v head slices to match original ordering), (3) both remap+permute. compare Rouge-L and kvcache heatmaps.
zoe: CI: ci-bot shows conversion pipeline produced warnings: "tokenizer-normalizer-mismatch" and "head-ordering-changed" in logs (/artifacts/orionbridge_conv_20260327/log.txt).
ci-bot: eval-bot queued small-run: summarization-small + emoji-accent-slice (run ev_3377).
miguel: infra: deploy-bot, can you snapshot orionbridge-conv-int4 for dev?
deploy-bot: snapshot queued: orionbridge-conv-int4-remaptest-20260327 (req rq_f47a). ETA ~40m.
rahul: I'll try (2) first (rotary-permute) to see if longctx is restored; it's faster because we only permute arrays and reserialize int4. if Rouge-L recovers, vocab mismatch is secondary.
zoe: I'll run (1) embed-id remap in parallel and dump token-delta histogram. if both individually recover ~50% of delta, we have additive problem.
miguel: note for remap: ensure to remap any tied weights and embedding projection matrices (lm_head and output bias). last time we forgot tied output projection and it produced punctuation collapse.
rahul: also instrument attention heatmap hook to record per-head attention norm over tokens 0..1024. if headwise rotary misapply, we'll see diagonal banding and phase flips.
zoe: okay. tagging @miguel @rahul. will post results in this thread when runs complete. coffee time. :coffee:
